gold_points: First quarter revenues are lowest due to cold, wet weather and customers finalizing capital budgets
Third quarter revenues are typically highest because more projects are underway and weather is better
Fourth quarter is lower than third but higher than second as customers spend capital budgets
Canadian projects are often stronger in first quarter because work is done while ground is frozen
output.note: Seasonality paragraph is fully contained in the first chunk; the second chunk covers weather and demand, not needed.
